name: Azure DevOps
changes: The release manager's acts are its own tools: create-release and start-stage make their fact once, read first, and release-status reads the stage to its approval and its end, each answering a receipt Daoris journals on the step the agent holds. The release steps stay for runs bound to them; approve-release stays no agent's tool, and given a release id Azure DevOps does not answer it says the release was not found.
description: Daoris's work on Azure DevOps through its REST API, with the personal access token its own login keeps: pull-request opens a pull request from the branch Daoris pushed, sets auto-complete where asked, and reads its state and merge commit; release follows the merged commit's build and release to their end.

commands.name: login
commands.about: Keeps a personal access token for Azure DevOps' REST API in this plugin's own storage. Without one, the plugin uses the person's signed-in session in Daoris's browser.

commands.name: status
commands.about: Says whether a token is kept, since when, and whether Azure DevOps last refused it.

about.en: Opens an Azure DevOps pull request from a pushed branch into its target (the repository's default branch where none is named), or finds the active one; its data is the pull request's id, address and state.
about.zh: 从已推送的分支向目标分支（未指定则为仓库默认分支）创建 Azure DevOps 拉取请求，已有进行中的则直接找到；数据为拉取请求的编号、地址和状态。

title.en: Delete the source branch on completion
Transition linked work items on completion
title.zh: 完成时转换关联工作项

about.en: Says whether a pull request, named by its address or id or found from its branch, is open, completed or abandoned, with its address and merge commit as data.
about.zh: 说明一个拉取请求（按地址或编号指定，或从其分支找到）是进行中、已完成还是已放弃，数据含地址和合并提交。

title.zh: 拉取请求的地址或编号

about.en: Completes an active pull request by the merge strategy asked (merge where none is), its policies still deciding; one already completed is said so.
about.zh: 按所要求的合并策略（未指定则为合并）完成进行中的拉取请求，仍由其策略决定；已完成的会如实说明。

title.zh: 拉取请求的地址或编号

about.en: Lists, for a repository's pipelines (or the one named), the release definitions taking their builds, each stage with what starts it and the earliest act that deploys into it, their continuous-deployment triggers and their links, as candidates for a release target; it writes nothing and chooses none.
about.zh: 列出仓库的流水线（或所指定的那一条）的构建被哪些发布定义采用，每个阶段由什么启动、最早由哪一动作部署，以及持续部署触发器和链接，作为发布目标的候选项；它不写入任何内容，也不替你选择。

about.en: The release manager's act: makes a release of the named definition from the merged pull request's build, once, keyed by its effect, or takes the one that already carries its commit, whoever made it; its data is the receipt Daoris journals on the step it holds (fact release-created).
about.zh: 发布负责人的动作：用已合并拉取请求的构建为指定的发布定义创建一次发布（按效果键，不会重复），已有携带该提交的发布则直接采用，无论由谁创建；数据为 Daoris 记入其所持步骤的回执（事实 release-created）。

title.en: Merged pull request's id or address
title.zh: 已合并拉取请求的编号或地址

about.en: The release manager's act: starts the named stage of the release carrying the merged commit, once, or takes it started by its trigger or a person; a stage asking an approval then waits on its approver. Its data is the receipt (fact stage-started).
about.zh: 发布负责人的动作：启动携带已合并提交的发布中的指定阶段，只启动一次；已由触发器或某人启动则直接采用；需要审批的阶段随后等待审批人。数据为回执（事实 stage-started）。

title.en: Merged pull request's id or address
title.zh: 已合并拉取请求的编号或地址

about.en: Reads the named stage of the release carrying the merged commit: ended (succeeded, or failed), or waiting, naming the approver a pending approval waits on. It writes nothing; its data is the receipt (fact stage-ended).
about.zh: 读取携带已合并提交的发布中的指定阶段：已结束（成功或失败），或仍在等待，并指出待审批项所等待的审批人。它不写入任何内容；数据为回执（事实 stage-ended）。

title.en: Merged pull request's id or address
title.zh: 已合并拉取请求的编号或地址

title.en: Approve or reject a release stage

about.en: The approver's own press: approves or rejects the pending approval of a release's stage through the approver's own sign-in. No agent is handed it.
about.zh: 审批人自己的操作：通过审批人自己的登录批准或拒绝某个发布阶段的待审批项。不会交给任何代理。

storage.for: The personal access token login keeps, and when Azure DevOps last refused it.

about.en: Opens an Azure DevOps pull request from the branch Daoris pushed to origin, or finds the active one, and sets auto-complete where its options ask. It sends nothing but its API calls, with the personal access token its own login keeps.
about.zh: 从 Daoris 已推送到 origin 的分支创建 Azure DevOps 拉取请求，已有进行中的则直接沿用，并按选项设置自动完成。只发送它的 API 请求，使用它自己登录时保存的个人访问令牌。

goal.en: Open an Azure DevOps pull request from the pushed branch into the line with create-pull-request (finding the active one where there is one), passing the step's options autoComplete, mergeStrategy, deleteSourceBranch, transitionWorkItems and mergeCommitMessage as its auto-complete arguments where they are given, check it with pull-request-status, and answer reached with its address as the evidence's url, its id as the pull-request output, and the tool's own words (its auto-complete sentence and its Way line) as the message; answer failed with the code a tool's refusal names where it cannot be opened.
goal.zh: 用 create-pull-request 从已推送的分支向主线创建 Azure DevOps 拉取请求（已有进行中的则找到它），步骤选项 autoComplete、mergeStrategy、deleteSourceBranch、transitionWorkItems、mergeCommitMessage 若给出则作为其自动完成参数传入，用 pull-request-status 确认，然后回答 reached，证据的 url 为其地址，pull-request 输出为其编号，message 取工具自己的话（自动完成一句和 Way 一行）；无法创建时回答 failed，代码取工具拒绝时给出的代码。

about.en: Acts only on the target its options declare by id: watches the declared stage of the merged build's release, or of its pipeline run, to its end, starting or making only what its action says; unresolved, it holds and lists what it found.
about.zh: 合并之后，只作用于其选项按编号声明的目标：所声明流水线对合并提交的构建，再跟踪所声明发布定义由该构建创建的发布中所声明的阶段（或流水线运行自身的阶段），直到结束。目标未声明或无法解析时，它会暂停并列出找到的候选项；只有在其操作要求时，才启动该阶段或创建该发布；审批和检查仍由 Azure DevOps 决定。

about.en: Reads the declared target again against the route of the branch the work merged into: reached naming the definition and stage, else failed no-target or target-changed with the route as the choice.
about.zh: 按工作合并进入的分支的路由重新核对所声明的目标：一致则以定义和阶段为证据完成，否则以 no-target 或 target-changed 失败，并给出路由作为可选项。

about.en: Settles on a release of the target carrying the landed commit, from any build, whoever made it; waits on the release manager meanwhile, then makes it once, keyed by its effect, where the action allows.
about.zh: 只要目标定义中已有携带已合并提交（来自其任一构建）的发布，无论由谁创建，即以此完成；构建运行及持续部署的等待期间，等待发布负责人；之后在操作允许时按其效果键只创建一次发布。

about.en: Settles on the declared stage started, by its trigger, a person or here; starts it only where the action says, else waits on the deployer.
about.zh: 所声明的阶段一经启动（由触发器、某人或此处启动）即完成；仅当操作要求时才在此启动，否则等待部署人。

about.en: Settles on the stage's approval as Azure DevOps records it, credited to its approver, or at once where the stage asks none; it never approves: the approver approves on the card or in Azure DevOps.
about.zh: 以 Azure DevOps 记录的阶段审批完成，并记在审批人名下；阶段无需审批则立即完成。它从不自行审批：由审批人在卡片上或在 Azure DevOps 中审批。

about.en: Watches the declared stage to its end: reached where it ends as its success asks, failed where it fails or is cancelled.
about.zh: 跟踪所声明的阶段直到结束：按成功要求结束则完成，失败或取消则失败。

tools.for: Runs the plugin's plugin.mjs, its calls to Azure DevOps' REST API (fetch), and its connection to Daoris's browser (WebSocket).
